purpose: Multi-version Institution scale-out tranche v27: materialize five remaining institutions with 3 direct and 2 partial repository provenance while preserving exact source granularity and non-propagation.
migrationRule: An Institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Institution dossier. Direct rows remain proposition-limited; partial rows preserve explicit locator/mapping gaps. Neither identity, adjudication, oversight, remediation, State context nor source adjacency creates a Claim/EvidenceItem, Material Participation finding or governance outcome.
visualRule: Derived visuals encode State context and source granularity, then terminate at the institution identity boundary. R/S/U/N context never propagates to the institution and partial rows visibly retain their evidence-curation gap.
